in_marathi.name: Bubun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bubun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bubhuh’, meaning ‘to bless’. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of prosperity and good fortune. The name is a blessing for a child, symbolizing the hope for a life filled with happiness and abundance.
